Short_Description:
WARLORD: +1 CP
Always: Re-roll Advances

Riled Up: 5++, Assault Ranged, Advance & Charge. Lasts thru end of turn.
Long_Description:
Army Rule
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain a CP.

Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
- Re-roll advance rolls.
- Become riled up, as stated in other rules.

While a unit is riled up:
- That unit has 5+ InSv.
- That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
- When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

Short_Description: Friendly ORKS melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Long_Description: Friendly ORKS units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: ORKS model only. If this unit charged this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model's melee attacks have +1 AP.

Short_Description: ORKS model only. Once per battle, per army: in your Movement phase, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Short_Description: ORKS model only. Fall Back does not prevent this unit from shooting or charging.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

Short_Description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" M.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" M.

Short_Description: Any phase: attached ORKS INFANTRY that becomes Battle-shocked takes D3 MW and is no longer Battle-shocked.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

EFFECT: Roll one D3:
- Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.
- Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

Short_Description: Fight: ORKS unit’s melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS].
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Short_Description: Fight: non-TITANIC ORKS models fight-on-death on 4+ (3+ if riled up).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up.
- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Short_Description: Fight: charging non-WALKER ORKS VEHICLE melee gains [CLEAVE 1] (or +1 CLEAVE).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have:
- [CLEAVE 1]
- Or if that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

Short_Description: Movement: ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit gets +2" M.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS unit’s ranged attacks gain [RAPID FIRE 1] (or +1 RAPID FIRE).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
- [RAPID FIRE 1]
- Or if that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

Short_Description: FIGHT: ORKS can re‑roll To Wound within loot objective.
Long_Description:
WHEN: The Fight phase.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re‑roll the wound roll.

Short_Description:
BIG MEK or PAINBOY. At Battle’s start, roll D3 to determine Bionik ability: 
1) Bionik Legs +2″ to Move 
2) Bionik Arms +1 Strength in melee 
3) Bionik Bonce WS +1
Long_Description: BIG MEK or Painboy model only. At the start of the battle, roll one D3 and compare the result to the list below. Until the end of the battle, models in the bearer’s unit have that bioniks ability: 1. Bionik Legs – add 2″ to the Move characteristic of this model; 2. Bionik Arms – add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model; 3. Bionik Bonce – improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.

Short_Description: MOVEMENT: ORKS Advance flat 6″ instead of rolling.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6″ to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Short_Description: WAGON. Units disembarking gain +1 to Charge until end of turn.
Long_Description: WAGON unit only. When a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, that unit has +1 to charge rolls until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: WAGON. Units disembarking gain +1 to Charge until end of turn.
Long_Description: WAGON unit only. When a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, that unit has +1 to charge rolls until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: SHOOTING: BATTLEWAGONs ranged attacks (excluding Firing Deck) have [RAPID FIRE X], where X equals the attack’s A.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLEWAGON unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That BATTLEWAGON unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding attacks made by weapons selected with Firing Deck) have [RAPID FIRE X], where X is that attack’s A.

Short_Description: ENEMY SHOOTING: After enemy shot, ORKS INFANTRY can shoot back. Snap shooting but may only target that enemy.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit has shot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Short_Description: ORKS INFANTRY model. Ranged have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS].
Long_Description: ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model’s ranged attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS].

Short_Description: ORKS. Once per battle round, friendly battle‑shocked ORKS within 12″; suffers D3 mortals and no longer battle‑shocked.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly ORKS unit that is battle‑shocked and within 12″ of the bearer. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and is no longer battle‑shocked.

Short_Description: ORKS INFANTRY. Ranged have [RAPID FIRE 1]; if already [RAPID FIRE], then +1 Rapid Fire.
Long_Description: ORKS INFANTRY unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1], or if that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

Short_Description: SHOOTING: ORKS ranged get [BLAST] when targeting INFANTRY.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit targets an INFANTRY unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon has the [BLAST] ability.

Short_Description: INFANTRY ranged have [ASSAULT].  In addition whe RILED UP ranged get  [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
Long_Description:
Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

In your Shooting phase, if the Waaagh! is active for your army, friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: Start of Command: Select Loot objective. ORKS INFANTRY, MOUNTED, WALKER attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] if they STAND in it or TARGET units within it.
Long_Description: At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker; until the start of your next Command phase, that marker is your loot objective. Each time a model in an ORKS INFANTRY, ORKS MOUNTED or ORKS WALKER unit from your army makes an attack, that attack has [SUSTAINED HITS 1] if the unit is within range of your loot objective or if the attack targets a unit within range of your loot objective.

Short_Description:
WAGON re‑rolls Charge & Advance flat 6". 

BATTLEWAGON, HUNTA & KILL RIG.
Long_Description:
Friendly BATTLEWAGON, HUNTA RIG, KILL RIG units have WAGON. 

Friendly WAGON units can re‑roll charge rolls. When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to make an advance move, that unit can change advance rolls to a 6. 

This detachment has the WAGONS tag and cannot be taken with another WAGONS detachment.

Short_Description: FIGHT: A WAGON unit that charged this turn has melee attacks with [CLEAVE 1].
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Fight phase, when a friendly WAGON unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1].

Short_Description: ORKS. Ranged weapons in bearer’s unit [IGNORES COVER].
Long_Description: ORKS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Short_Description:
COMMAND: ORKS* within loot objective get the Waaagh! until next Command phase.
*Excludes Gretchin.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units) that is within range of the loot objective.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle.

Short_Description: CHARGE: After WAGON ends Charge, each engaged enemy make battle‑shock at -1.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle‑shock roll, with –1 to that battle‑shock roll.

Short_Description: ENEMY MOVEMENT: After an enemy falls back, ORKS that was engaged can make a normal move of up to 6″.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit falls back.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that was within engagement range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is not within range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6″.

Short_Description: SHOOTING: ORKS INFANTRY ranged have [IGNORES COVER].
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Short_Description: ORKS. After deployment, redeploy up to three ORKS INFANTRY; they may go to Reserves regardless of limits.
Long_Description: ORKS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ORKS INFANTRY units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: SHOOTING: Flash Gitz ranged gain [ANTI‑VEHICLE 4+] for the phase.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Flash Gitz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI‑VEHICLE 4+] ability.

Short_Description: SHOOTING: ORKS INFANTRY ranged target within 9″ have AP -1.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9″ have +1 AP.

Short_Description:
WAGON. With BIG MEK embarked, ranged attacks IGNORE COVER 

If Waaagh! is active, they also gain SUSTAINED HITS 1
Long_Description: WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK model is embarked within this unit, this unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. If the Waaagh! is active for this unit, this unit’s ranged attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description:
BOYZ melee [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Charging INFANTRY: [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] in Melee
Long_Description:
Friendly BOYZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a charge move this turn, that unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Short_Description:
ORKS INFANTRY model.
Melee +1 A, or +2 A if 11+ models.
Long_Description:
ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model's melee attacks have:
- +1 A
- Or, if this unit has 11+ models, +2 A.

Short_Description: BOYZ unit only. This unit has 4+ Sv.
Long_Description: BOYZ unit only. This unit has 4+ Sv.

Short_Description: Fight: charging BOYZ melee +1 A.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 A.

Short_Description: Command Battle-shock step: ORKS INFANTRY 13+ models auto-pass Battle-shock for a visible ORKS unit within 12".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.

EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit's battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

Short_Description: Movement: BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ +2 to Advance rolls.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.

Short_Description: Friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ melee has [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Long_Description: Friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: NOBZ unit only. Engaged enemy that Falls Back must use desperate escape; -1 hazard rolls if this unit is riled up.
Long_Description:
NOBZ unit only. When an enemy unit engaged with this unit is selected to make a fall-back move:
- That enemy unit must select the desperate escape mode.
- If this unit is riled up, that enemy unit has -1 to the hazard rolls made for that desperate escape.

Short_Description: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This unit (excluding VEHICLE) has Deep Strike.
Long_Description: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This unit (excluding VEHICLE units) has Deep Strike.

Short_Description: Fight: MEGANOBZ/NOBZ fight-on-death on 4+ (3+ if riled up).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:
- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Short_Description: Shooting or Fight: MEGANOBZ/NOBZ re-roll hit 1s; if riled up, re-roll hits.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks can:
- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.

Short_Description: Opp shooting: MEGANOBZ/NOBZ, S>T ranged -1 to Wound (1CP); or all ranged -1 to Wound (+1CP).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

Or +1CP: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

Short_Description: STORMBOYZ have BATTLELINE. BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ can Fall Back and still charge.
Long_Description:
Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE.

When a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Short_Description: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. While part of an attached unit, this model has Infiltrators and Stealth.
Long_Description:
BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. While this model is part of an attached unit, this model has:
- Infiltrators
- Stealth

Short_Description: KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit only. Melee has [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
Long_Description: KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit only. This unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Short_Description: Start/end of your Movement: BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ controlling an objective secures it.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Short_Description: Movement: BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ Advance/Fall Back can still start an action.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Short_Description: End of opponent's Movement: unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ that was engaged can Normal move 6".
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

Short_Description: BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS re-roll hit 1s if they or their target are in range of an objective.
Long_Description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit is selected to shoot, if any of the following apply, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1:
- That unit is within range of an objective.
- The target of that attack is within range of an objective.

Short_Description: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY only. After deployment, redeploy up to 3 ORKS INFANTRY; can go into Strategic Reserves ignoring limits.
Long_Description: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

Short_Description: FLASH GITZ unit only. Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].
Long_Description: FLASH GITZ unit only. This unit's Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS TRANSPORT Firing Deck weapons +1 to hit.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description: After shooting: unengaged BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS Normal move 6" onto an objective; cannot charge this turn.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.

TARGET: That BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit.

EFFECT:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.
- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: Opp shooting: FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS hit by that enemy can shoot back at only that enemy.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Short_Description: BEAST SNAGGA attacks that target MONSTER/VEHICLE have +1 AP.
Long_Description: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units' attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 AP.

Short_Description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. Fall Back does not prevent this unit from charging.
Long_Description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Short_Description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model has +1 T.
Long_Description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model has +1 T.

Short_Description: Opp Movement: enemy Falling Back from BEAST SNAGGA must desperate-escape; MONSTER/VEHICLE takes extra hazard rolls.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

Short_Description: Opp Shooting: unengaged BEAST SNAGGA that lost a wound surge D6" (re-roll if riled up).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.

Short_Description: End of opp Fight: unengaged BEAST SNAGGA within 6" of a battlefield edge goes into Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Short_Description: When BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET puts all ranged attacks into one enemy, roll D6 table.
Long_Description:
In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit's ranged attacks target a single enemy unit, roll one D6:

UNPREDICTABLE GENIUS
D6  RESULT
1  Dat's Weird: The target unit has 4+ InSv until your unit has shot.
2-3  Hop Splat: Select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
4  Seekerz: Those attacks have +1 to hit rolls.
5  Lifted: The target unit has FLY, and cannot have the benefit of cover, until your unit has shot.
6  Runtified: The target unit has -1 T until your unit has shot.

Short_Description: BIG MEK model only. This unit is riled up.
Long_Description: BIG MEK model only. This unit is riled up.

Short_Description: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN: on shoot, D6 — 1 Torrent then destroyed; 2-5 +1 A; 6 Sustained Hits 2.
Long_Description:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can roll one D6:
- On a 1, this model's Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [TORRENT], and when this unit has shot, this model is destroyed.
- On a 2-5, this model's Shokk Attack Gun weapon has +1 A.
- On a 6, this model's Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [SUSTAINED HITS 2].

Short_Description: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN: after shooting, one hit enemy is infested with Snotlings (−1 Leadership).
Long_Description:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is infested with Snotlings until the start of your next turn.
- While an enemy unit is infested with Snotlings, that unit has -1 to leadership rolls.

Short_Description: Shooting: MEK GUNZ choose Lethal Hits, or Sustained Hits 1, or Hazardous+Lethal+Sustained 1.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That MEK GUNZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
- [LETHAL HITS]
- Or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
- Or [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description:
TRY DAT BUTTON! D6
1-2  +1 A
3-4  +2 S
5-6  +1 AP

2D6 get HAZARDOUS (keep dups)
Non-TITANIC ORKS WALKER
Long_Description:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units) is selected to attack, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit's attacks have the relevant rule(s):

TRY DAT BUTTON!
D6  RESULT
1-2  +1 A
3-4  +2 S
5-6  +1 AP

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one hazard roll.

Short_Description: BIG MEK/MEK model only. This model has +2" M.
Long_Description: BIG MEK/MEK model only. This model has +2" M.

Short_Description: BIG MEK: within 3" of friendly ORKS WALKER (not BIG MEK) — Lone Operative; one WALKER within 3" re-rolls hit 1s.
Long_Description:
BIG MEK model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding BIG MEK units):
- This model has Lone Operative.
- In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. That unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: Fight: non-TITANIC ORKS WALKER fight-on-death on 4+ (+3 if DEFF DREAD).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:
- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Short_Description: Movement: one WALKER is RILED UP
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Short_Description: Movement or Charge:  WALKER gains MOBILE.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

Short_Description: WAGON units re-roll charge rolls and can change Advance rolls to 6.
Long_Description:
Friendly WAGON units can re-roll charge rolls.

When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to make an advance move, that unit can change advance rolls to a 6.

Short_Description: WAGON with embarked BIG MEK: ranged [IGNORES COVER]; if riled up also [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Long_Description:
WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK model is embarked within this unit:
- This unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
- If this unit is riled up, this unit's ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: WAGON with embarked WARBOSS gains that WARBOSS's Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin' ability.
Long_Description: WAGON unit only. While a WARBOSS model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that WARBOSS model's Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin' ability.

Short_Description: End of Fight: unengaged ORKS INFANTRY that could fight, wholly within 6" of a TRANSPORT it can embark, embarks.
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

Short_Description: Movement: after a WAGON ends a Normal move, embarked units can assault disembark.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.

Short_Description: Charge: after WAGON ends a charge, each engaged enemy Battle-shock at -1.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Short_Description: WARBIKERS have BATTLELINE. SPEED FREEKS Advance/Fall Back: ranged [ASSAULT] this turn and can still charge.
Long_Description:
Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE.

When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move:
That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Short_Description: SPEED FREEKS (not AIRCRAFT): if an attack loses full visibility because of a model in this unit, the target has cover vs that attack.
Long_Description: SPEED FREEKS unit only (excluding AIRCRAFT units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

Short_Description: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.
Long_Description: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

Short_Description: Movement: RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES heals 3 wounds on any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY within 3".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit.

EFFECT: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

Short_Description: Shooting: SPEED FREEKS ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Short_Description: Opp Shooting: ranged attacks vs SPEED FREEKS fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

Short_Description: ORKS AIRCRAFT ignore Strategic Reserves points cap. Riled up ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS ranged +1 to hit.
Long_Description:
Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your strategic reserves units.

While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description: ORKS AIRCRAFT: unit is CHARACTER. After an ingress move, friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS within 6" are riled up until start of your next turn.
Long_Description:
ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only.
- This unit has CHARACTER.
- When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" of this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Short_Description: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In the first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
Long_Description: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Short_Description: Any phase: destroyed ORKS AIRCRAFT skips Deadly Demise; one enemy within 12" takes 8D6, each 4+ = 1 MW; then remove the aircraft.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:
- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS re-roll hits vs FLY.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit's ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

Short_Description: Opp Movement: unengaged DEFFKOPTAS within 8" of an enemy that ended a move can Normal move D6" (6" if riled up).
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
- Up to D6".
- Or, if your unit is riled up, up to 6".

Short_Description: WARBOSS  Fight on death 3+ or 2+ if RILED UP
Long_Description:
When a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is riled up.
- On a 3+, do not remove this WARBOSS model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this WARBOSS model is removed from the battlefield.

Short_Description: INFANTRY WARBOSS. Once per battle, per army: after this model is destroyed, on a 2+ return it with 3 wounds.
Long_Description:
INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
- On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

Short_Description: WARBOSS model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 D.
Long_Description: WARBOSS model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 D.

Short_Description: WARBOSS. A TRANSPORT this unit is embarked within (excluding WALKER) has +2" M and 5+ InSv.
Long_Description:
WARBOSS model only. A TRANSPORT unit (excluding WALKER units) this unit is embarked within has:
- +2" M
- 5+ InSv.

Short_Description: WARBOSS model only. Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
Long_Description: WARBOSS model only. This model can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Short_Description: WARBOSS. Once per battle, per army: end of opponent's Movement phase, if unengaged, Normal move up to D6"; if riled up, re-roll that D6.
Long_Description:
WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of:
- Up to D6".
- If this unit is riled up, you can re-roll that D6.

Short_Description: WARBOSS model only. Gains Da Gobshot Thunderbuss.
Long_Description:
WARBOSS model only. This model has the following weapon:
Da Gobshot Thunderbuss [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE, RAPID FIRE 6]
Range 24", A 6, BS 4+, S 7, AP -2, D 2.

Short_Description: ORKS PSYKER [PSYCHIC] attacks gain +1 S, plus +1 S per 5 models in/embarked with the unit. ORKS PSYKERS gain Roar of Mork and Visions of Violence.
Long_Description:
Friendly ORKS PSYKER models' [PSYCHIC] attacks have:
- +1 S.
- +1 S for every 5 models in this unit (or embarked within this model).

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models have the following psychic abilities:

Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 from that battle-shock roll for every 10 models in this unit.

Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit has Fights First.

Short_Description: ORKS PSYKER model only. Gains Da Krunch.
Long_Description:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the following weapon:
Da Krunch [BLAST 3, HAZARDOUS, LETHAL HITS, PSYCHIC]
Range 24", A 3, BS 4+, S 5, AP -1, D 1.

Short_Description: ORKS PSYKER model only. Gains 'Eadbanger.
Long_Description:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the following weapon:
'Eadbanger [HAZARDOUS, PRECISION, PSYCHIC]
Range 24", A 2, BS 4+, S 6, AP -3, D 1.

Short_Description: ORKS PSYKER model only. Psyker level 2, Deadly Demise D6, and can re-roll psychic rolls.
Long_Description:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model:
- Has psyker level 2.
- Has Deadly Demise D6.
- Can re-roll psychic rolls.

Short_Description: GRETCHIN have BATTLELINE. Advance/Fall Back does not prevent GRETCHIN from starting an action.
Long_Description:
Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE.
When a friendly GRETCHIN unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Short_Description: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.
Long_Description: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

Short_Description: GRETCHIN unit only. While not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".
Long_Description: GRETCHIN unit only. While this unit is not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".

Short_Description: Any phase: when a GRETCHIN unit is destroyed after an enemy attacks, return an identical unit in Strategic Reserves at starting strength and full wounds.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.

TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.

Short_Description: Opponent Movement: unengaged GRETCHIN within 8" of an enemy that ended a move can Normal move D6", or 6" if attached.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.

TARGET: That GRETCHIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
- Up to D6".
- Or, up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting: a nearby GRETCHIN unit can absorb hits against a non-GRETCHIN ORKS INFANTRY unit, suffering 1 mortal wound per intercepted hit.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).

TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When a hit roll for that enemy unit's ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Short_Description: ORKS INFANTRY ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. While riled up, ranged attacks have +3" R.
Long_Description:
Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units' ranged attacks have:
- [ASSAULT].
- While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

Short_Description: ORKS INFANTRY model (excluding MEKBOY): ranged attacks gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+], [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], and [SUPA-HAZARDOUS].
Long_Description:
ORKS INFANTRY model only (excluding MEKBOY models). This model's ranged attacks have:
- [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+].
- [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
- [SUPA-HAZARDOUS].

[SUPA-HAZARDOUS]: Each time a unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make two hazard rolls for that unit for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon you selected in the Select Weapons step.

Short_Description: BIG MEK/BIGBOSS/WARBOSS model only. Ranged attacks excluding [TORRENT] have +3" R.
Long_Description: BIG MEK/BIGBOSS/WARBOSS model only. This unit's ranged attacks (excluding [TORRENT] attacks) have +3" R.

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS INFANTRY ranged attacks get +1 to wound against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS INFANTRY ranged attacks against a unit within 9" have +1 AP.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

Short_Description: Shooting: ORKS INFANTRY ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
